article.headline: Morgan State defeats Central Penn 123-70
article.description: — Wynston Tabbs had 27 points in Morgan State's 123-70 win over Central Penn on Sunday night.

categories.description: Central Penn Knights @ Morgan State Bears

event.description: Central Penn Knights @ Morgan State Bears

keywords: Central Penn Knights @ Morgan State Bears
article.story: BALTIMORE -- — Wynston Tabbs had 27 points in Morgan State's 123-70 win over Central Penn on Sunday night. Tabbs added three steals for the Bears (4-6). Rob Lawson scored 20 points and added five assists. Will Thomas shot 7 for 11 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line to finish with 19 points. Dahsan King led the Knights in scoring, finishing with 17 points and two steals. Khalil Dukes added 12 points for Central Penn, a member of the United States Collegiate Athletic Association. Anthony McClinton also had six points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
